description: Gradient-domain grading suite in a single OFX bundle: halo-free local contrast and clarity (Field Sharpen GD Pro), gradient-domain hue and saturation shaping (Color Vector GD Pro), and edge-aware selective grading (Color Slicer GD Pro). GPU-accelerated on Metal and CUDA.
releaseHighlights:
- GD DRT Pro: new Records tonal engine, now the only engine in this build. The picture is built from three overlapping film like records, each with a fast and a slow layer, recombined as dye density. Hue and saturation fall out of the records instead of a hue table, so colour gradations are smoother and the neutral axis stays exactly where Tone Shape put it.
- GD DRT Pro: five new Records controls. Record Crosstalk, Highlight Crosstalk, Interimage, Dye Impurity and Density Range.
- GD DRT Pro: pushing exposure down no longer breaks the Records look.
- Much faster at 4K on Mac. GD DRT Pro went from about 7 fps to about 40 fps on a 4K timeline, with the exact same picture.
- Windows and Linux: Razzle Dazzle, Theater Light, HDR Restore (Deband and Highlight Expand), Structure Metric and the Achromatic Test and Colour Leak views now render on CUDA. Before this build they were Mac only.
- Windows and Linux: CUDA speed work. GPU memory is reused between frames instead of being allocated every frame, and needless waits between the CPU and GPU are gone.
- Windows and Linux: fixed the CUDA build.

availableVersions.releaseHighlights:
- New tool: GD DRT Pro. A subtractive display transform where the emitter white is the high anchor and the image is carved out from it. Volume, tone shape, pin knee, shoulder models, dye twist, Sat/Density split, Diffuse, Scorched, Bleach and black anchor controls.
- New in GD DRT Pro: Reference Monitor dropdown. Tell the node what the look was built on (Gamma 2.4 SDR or PQ) and switching Display Encode to PQ, HLG or back to Gamma 2.4 keeps the light you graded instead of rescaling raw numbers.
- New in GD DRT Pro: SDR Monitor Match. SDR Monitor White and SDR Monitor Black trims so the Gamma 2.4 output lines up with the monitor you actually grade on.
- New tool: Theater Light DRT. A projector-through-dye picture former with per-layer trims, Color Timing, black Dmax, white anchor and per-layer MTF.
- New tool: SD>HD GDR Delivery. A timeline level re-target from an SDR grade to a PQ or HLG deliverable with an optional Rec.709 to Rec.2020 gamut step and no solve.
- Peak Luminance (nits), HDR Grey Lift and PQ (ST 2084) and HLG Display Encode options across the DRT tools.
- GD DRT Experiments: TS Lever and TS Lever Drive render modes, per-primary Lever Drive trims, Dye Density and Dye Purity coupling, N-Primary Drive engine and a three mode Gamut Compress.
- Windows and Linux CUDA builds compiled against CUDA 13 in CI and verified bit-exact against the CPU path in the parity harness. They have not yet been eyeballed on NVIDIA hardware, so please report anything that looks off.
